scenario.summary: Guest opens a configurable product with checkbox add-ons, picks the variant by attributes, selects three checkbox add-ons by name, adds to cart and verifies the line item lists the variant attributes and the three add-ons.
steps: Search the configurable parent SKU and open it
Select the variant's Bulb Size, Color and Technology
Select three checkbox add-ons by name
Add to Cart and open the cart
Verify the line item description (attributes and 'Checkbox : <add-on>' lines)
stateChanges: Guest cart: the variant with three add-ons is added (not removed by this method; the radio method empties the cart first)
assertions: Line item description equals 'Bulb Size : <v>', 'Color : <v>', 'Technology : <v>' and one 'Checkbox : <add-on>' line per selected add-on
evidence: Method ZPD-TC-5159: configurable product with checkbox add-ons on the cart. Independent method (priority 45, no dependsOn).

Read by the page object, not scanned: ProductDisplayPage.selectConfigurableAttributes(pdpDataMap, <variant column>) reads rows ProductSize, ProductColor and Technology of the variant's column -> product.variant1Attr1 (BulbSize), variant1Attr2 (Color), variant1Attr3 (Technology) (order of variantAttributes). No source entries: the cells are not in the scan and the workbook is not read.

The add-ons are clicked by name: AddOnFirst/Second/ThirdProduct -> product.addOnName / addOn2Name / addOn3Name (drafted optional outputs on PRODUCT_CONFIGURABLE_WITH_VARIANTS: the parent's priced, active add-on products of the CheckBox groups in display order).
Gap (params): the test selects three add-on products; minAddOns counts add-on groups, so a fallback product may have fewer than three (addOn3Name null).

AddOnConfigurableProduct is composed: 'Bulb Size : <variant1Attr1>', 'Color : <variant1Attr2>', 'Technology : <variant1Attr3>', then '<addOnGroupName> : <addOnName>' per selected add-on; data without output, built by the migrated test.
Profile (Playwright observations): z-2510006 is an active SimpleProduct (variant), inventory 1000; b-100002 not profiled.

Store: openWebstoreUrl opens automation_webStoreUrl (atstage: webstore-z10-atstage, the main store MaxwellsHardware; centralizedLoginEnabled=no), the same store as the Playwright webstore entries. Guest flow, no sign-in.
Profile: work/profiles/profile.json (2026-11-01) was not run for these Selenium tests (profiled false); Playwright observations of the same SKUs are cited where they exist.
Scanned constant values (locators, report messages, delays) are framework constants: role config, no need.
migrate: Selenium reads Excel tables through TestData.getMap; there is no swap for Selenium.
